Dorian Lynn

RN  ·  Reiki Master  ·  Intuitive Mystic Healer

Dorian Lynn is a Registered Nurse with more than twenty years of healthcare experience and Reiki Master expertise. As the founder of Mystic Medicine Boutique, she creates spiritual wellness education and resources for people navigating profound spiritual upheaval, life transitions, and the questions that arise when ordinary support is no longer enough.

She created Mystic Medicine Boutique to address a gap she witnessed throughout her nursing career: people navigating profound spiritual upheaval often struggled to find resources that felt both spiritually meaningful and grounded in an understanding of real-world crises.

That work — over a decade in the making — exists for the moments when life becomes too big for ordinary advice.
